_readme: Client wiring for DayZ-MCP (https://github.com/willy92wins/dayz-mcp), the bridge described in
knowledge/dayz-mcp-bridge-protocol.md. Clone that repo and run tools/install-mcp.ps1
-Register; it creates tools/.venv-mcp and registers this exact shape. Copy to
.mcp.json in your own project and set 'command' to that venv's python.exe.
Deliberately NOT named .mcp.json: agents auto-start servers declared there, and a
failed launch on every session is worse than no config.
MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS raises the per-tool output cap so screenshots come back at a
usable resolution; at the 25k default a frame lands around 580 px wide.
